preconditions.description: The number of tasks is between 1 and 10,000.
The cooldown period is between 0 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(task_i in 'A'..'Z' for task_i in tasks)
preconditions.description: Each task is represented by an uppercase English letter.

postconditions.description: The output is at least the number of tasks.

postconditions.expression: all(tasks.count(task) == 0 or tasks.index(task) - tasks.rindex(task, 0, tasks.index(task)) > K for task in set(tasks))
postconditions.description: The output ensures that no task is repeated less than K units of time apart.
